deep.reconstruction:
Context: in 1983-84 Grothendieck is building a 'space' X associated with a system Σ of pseudolines (a pseudoline arrangement in the real projective plane, together with its specializations and generalizations). He constructs a space 𝒳 by gluing local pieces and studies the natural map 𝒳 → X, asking when it is an immersion. To each pseudoline D he attaches a 2-cell Δ_D, apparently a local chart of the 'dual plane' of pseudolines near D. Its boundary circle ∂Δ_D parametrizes the directions in which D can be moved. A generalization D' → D (D' a perturbed position of D, moved off a vertex or past a crossing) is marked by an arc of generalization on ∂Δ_{D'}.

Orientations: an orientation ω of the cell Δ_D corresponds to an orientation ω_D of the line D. The linear model makes this natural. A line in RP^2 is a 2-plane in R^3. Orienting the line is the same as orienting the plane, which is the same as choosing a unit normal, i.e. a point of S^2. So the orientation double cover of the dual RP^2 and the cover 'orientations of the line' are both S^2 → RP^2, identified only up to the antipodal map. This is exactly where a sign ambiguity can enter.

The page continues the previous one. With the 'other choice' α = a, the gluing passes from Δ_D to Δ_{D'} along the transition arc and crosses the critical specialization line δ. Following the orientations continuously (diagram: ω on Δ_D ↔ ω_D on D, transported to ω' on Δ_{D'} ↔ ω_{D'} on D'), he again finds that ω_{D'} is OPPOSITE to the orientation obtained from ω_D by parallel transport. This holds in both gluing cases.

He then diagnoses two weeks of earlier work. He had previously taken parallel transport as the transition isomorphism for orientations. He had also identified the generalization arc on ∂Δ_{D'} with the arc obtained from b by parallel transport, whereas the correct one is the antipodal arc. So there were two compensating or confounding sign errors.

He then announces a list of the four possibilities: two choices of transition isomorphism × two choices of gluing (α = α' or α ≠ α'). The next page analyses them: in one case 𝒳 → X is an immersion; in the other it fails to be one along certain faces F*.
errors: No mathematical error on the page itself; the page is Grothendieck correcting his own earlier sign errors (transition isomorphism taken as parallel transport instead of its opposite; generalization arc taken as the parallel transport of b instead of its antipode).
The setup (precise definition of Δ_D, of X and 𝒳) is not on this page, so the correctness of the final sign convention cannot be fully verified from it alone.

ideas.what: Identification of orientations of a cell Δ_D in the space of (pseudo)lines with orientations of the line D, and the observation that the correct transition isomorphism across a specialization wall is opposite to parallel transport
ideas.modern_name: orientation local system of the dual projective plane vs. orientation cover of the tautological plane bundle (both the S^2 → RP^2 double cover, matched up to the antipodal map)

ideas.what: Building a space 𝒳 by gluing local cells along generalization/specialization arcs and testing whether 𝒳 → X is an immersion
ideas.modern_name: local models / realization space of pseudoline arrangements, stratified by combinatorial type (oriented-matroid strata)

missed.claim: Part of Grothendieck's unpublished attempt to build a space 𝒳 → X of pseudoline configurations by gluing cells along generalization arcs. The four gluing/orientation possibilities are listed here and analysed on the next page; the immersion question is not settled on this page.
missed.quote: Pour résumer les quatre possibilités sont indiquées dans la liste suivante
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only as documentation of Grothendieck's approach to moduli of pseudoline arrangements, a topic later developed via oriented matroids and Mnëv universality. The page itself contains sign bookkeeping, not a new result.

deep.surprise_reason: Working notes correcting orientation and antipodal sign conventions in a gluing construction. Historically interesting as part of the little-known pseudoline project, but no new result or connection is on this page.
transcription_corrections: 'le idée qui "fait jeu"' is more plausibly 'la [choix] qui "fait foi"' (the choice that is authoritative).
'mais par contre celle qui ne résulte par transport parallèle' → 'celle qui ne résulte pas du transport parallèle' (contrast with the antipodal choice).
'1°) de b avec à[?]' is likely '1°) de b avec a' (or a′), i.e. gluing of arc b with arc a, referring to case 1° of the earlier analysis.
'iso. de transition' is preceded by struck-out words; the reading 'j'avais pris comme iso. de transition pour les orientations le transport parallèle' is consistent with the image.
